eps.o: Hello Kitty is planning the perfect ramen picnic with Tuxedosam and can't wait to relax and enjoy the delicious noodles together! She's excited to capture the peaceful moment with photos and soak in the tranquility of their meal. But when Badtz-maru and Keroppi show up, eating their ramen and making all kinds of enthusiastic eating noises, Hello Kitty's quiet picnic quickly turns into something…

A curry cook-off has come to Sanrio Town, and Pompompurin and Cinnamoroll are so excited to attend! There's just one problem: Cinnamoroll doesn't like spicy things. As he tastes all his friends' curry creations, Pompompurin starts to worry that Cinnamoroll isn't having fun. But in reality, Cinnamoroll is just happy to try new things, and he even goes back for seconds!

It's a rainy day and Hello Kitty and friends are stuck inside, but that's not going to stop the fun! The supercute friends decide to build the ultimate blanket fort, and everyone gets their own special space to decorate however they like. Each friend adds their own personal touch to make their corner unique and special! But when the blanket fort comes tumbling down, they discover something even…

Pompompurin has big dreams of winning the annual Twins Day contest in Sanrio Town! But when he realizes Kiki and Lala are real twins, Cinnamoroll reminds him to try his best anyway. Can their double-trouble DJ service win over the judges and show the true spirit of friendship?

Hello Kitty and friends meet up in the garage to form a band! Kuromi takes charge of lead guitar but gets frustrated when Keroppi wants to play his cowbell, and Badtz-maru tries to play lead guitar too. The music sounds terrible because everyone wants different things! Luckily, Hello Kitty talks to Kuromi and helps her see that letting her friends shine in their own talents will make the band…

eps.t: Stargazing with Kiki and Lala Part 1
eps.o: Hello Kitty and friends gather for a magical night of stargazing, spotting constellations, and counting shooting stars! But when two bright stars zoom straight towards them, it's Kiki and Lala arriving with a spectacular surprise! Will the LittleTwinStars put on the most dazzling constellation show ever?
